svg.aria-label: The mission. 1. Build and test: Integrated the payload, then put it through thermal and vacuum chamber testing and flight readiness reviews. 2. Launch and ascent: A weather balloon carried it into the upper stratosphere, spin-stabilized on the way up. 3. Log the flight: The Arduino logged time, inside and outside temperature, and the Peltier voltage to an SD card. 4. Recover: After the balloon burst, the team tracked the payload by GPS and recovered it intact within 2 hours of touchdown.
